label: Figure 1
caption:
Figure 1. Overview of an early stage paclitaxel synthesis pathway and effective strategies for increasing precursor production. (a) Directed evolution
of the rate-limiting enzyme IDI and optimization of the MEP pathway expression. (b) Constructing substrate channels for improving Tax
production. (c) Combinatorial engineering of promoters and proteins for T5αOH-CPR and TAT to optimize the biosynthesis of T5OH and
T5OAc. (d) Application of cofactor engineering to enhance T10OH production. Insertion site A: noncoding sequence between ompW and yciE in
the locus; insertion site B: noncoding sequence between rulF and yjbD in the locus; IS1: insertion sequence 1. Endogenous enzymes and pathway
enzymes are shown in italicized text. G3P: glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate; Pyr: pyruvate; DXP: 1-deoxy-D-xylulose 5-phosphate; IPP: isopentenyl
diphosphate; DMAPP: dimethylallyl diphosphate; GGPP: geranylgeranyl diphosphate; Tax: taxadiene; T5OH: taxadien-5α-ol; T5OAc: taxadien-
5α-yl-acetate; T10OH: taxadiene-5α,10β-diol-5-acetate;
L-Glu-tRNA:
L-glutamate-tRNA; 5-ALA: 5-aminolevulinic acid; Acetyl-P: acetyl
phosphate; DXS: 1-deoxy-D-xylulose-5-phosphate synthase; IDI: isopentenyl diphosphate isomerase; GGPPS: geranylgeranyl diphosphate
synthase; TS: taxadiene synthase; T5αOH: taxadien-5α-hydroxylase; CPR: cytochrome P450 reductase; TAT: taxadien-5α-ol O-acetyltransferase;
T10βOH: taxane-10β-hydroxylase; ACS: acetyl-CoA synthetase; Zwf: glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase; PTA: phosphate acetyltransferase;
ACKA: acetate kinase. Genes overexpressed and knocked out are represented by ↑and ×, respectively.

label: Figure 2
caption:
Figure 2. Directed evolution of key enzymes and pathway optimization for enhancing Tax synthesis. (a) Schematic of the Tax biosynthesis pathway
and expression of associated enzymes. (b) Directed evolution of IDI and expression optimization of the MEP pathway. (c) Protein sequence
alignment of NtGGPPS and TcGGPPS. (d) Directed evolution of TcGGPPS for enhancing Tax production. GPP: geranylpyrophosphate; FPP:
farnesyl pyrophosphate.

label: Figure 3
caption:
Figure 3. Colocalization of enzymes to facilitate substrate channeling and enhance expression of pathway enzymes for increasing metabolic flux
toward Tax titer. (a) Schematic diagram of substrate channeling construction. (b) Optimizing Tax titer through rational design of multienzyme
scaffold systems. (c) Genomic integration of protein scaffolds to alleviate metabolic burden. (d) Optimizing Tax production through precise
control of inducer concentration. (e) Schematic illustration of the construction of a plasmid-free Tax-producing microbial strain. (f) Impact of TS
and GGPPS expression levels on Tax biosynthesis efficiency. Insertion site 1: noncoding sequence between rpnC and panC in the locus; insertion
site 2: noncoding sequence between tktB and ypfG in the locus; insertion site 3: noncoding sequence between aroG and gpmA in the locus;
insertion site 4: noncoding sequence between yghA and exbD in the locus; IS186: insertion sequence 186.

label: Figure 4
caption:
Figure 4. Combinatorial promoter and protein engineering of T5αOH-CPR and TAT to enhance the production of T5OH and T5OAc. (a)
Promoter engineering for optimizing expression of T5αOH-CPR to enhance T5OH titer. (b) Promoter engineering for optimizing expression of
TAT to enhance T5OAc titer. (c) Validation of promoter strength using a fluorescent protein reporter system. The “Control” refers to the control
strain, specifically the recombinant strain without mCherry addition.

label: Figure 5
caption:
Figure 5. Computational protein engineering of TAT using PROSS to improve T5OAc production. (a) Impact of single-site mutations on T5OAc
titer. (b) Effects of saturation mutagenesis and combinatorial mutagenesis on T5OAc titer. (c) Enhancing intracellular acetyl-CoA availability to
improve T5OAc titer. N.D., not detected.

label: Figure 6
caption:
Figure 6. Cofactor engineering of T5αOH and T10βOH to enhance T10OH production. (a) Effects of culture conditions on the biosynthesis of
metabolites. (b) Endogenous heme biosynthesis pathway in E. coli. (c) Scheme of the NADPH metabolic recycling pathway. (d) Overview of the
construction of cofactor-engineered strains. (e) Analysis of metabolite production in strains with engineered cofactor metabolism. (f) Analysis of
heme-enriched engineered strains. N.D., not detected. Insertion site A: noncoding sequence between ompW and yciE in the locus; insertion site B:
noncoding sequence between rulF and yjbD in the locus.
